shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 3 on the number line on the left with the mark at 2 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed interval excludes its boundary value 3. Right image: The displayed interval excludes its boundary value 2.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow dot makes equality at 3 inadmissible for the interval. On the right, the hollow dot makes equality at 2 inadmissible for the interval.
